verdict.rationale: New Relic's official CLI is documented for automation use, explicitly including "adding New Relic into your CI/CD pipeline" (docs-51). It has machine-readable JSON/YAML output (docs-52), credential profiles that apply to any command (docs-53), and scriptable tasks such as deployment markers and entity search (gh-1, gh-2, docs-38). Programmatic NerdGraph API access (docs-2), Terraform-based declarative management (docs-42) and the nrdiag CLI with an -api-key flag (docs-62) add further headless paths. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and documented non-interactive auth (e.g., env-var API keys) or an official CI integration such as a GitHub Action.
